Max and Mia are very motivated to protect the environment.

They want to know how recycling methods can be improved in order to cut back on waste.

Explore Max’s and Mia's questions:

1. What does it mean to recycle?
2. How could recyclable materials be sorted in your area?
3. Can you imagine devices that can sort recyclable waste according to its shape?

Share your ideas in the Documentation tool.

Use the bricks:

Build a truck that can sort the two objects based on shape.
<font size="3">Program your truck bed to drop small recyclable objects at the recycling station.</font>

Turn on the Smarthub and connect it to your device. Watch the video if you need help.

Refer to the Help panel for more guidance.

Design a solution:

Modify the truck to sort objects into two different groups based on their shape.

Consider one of the following:
1. Change the truck bed design.
2. Use the Motion Sensor Input to detect the shape of the object.
3. Sort objects in the truck.

Document your solution by explaining how you have used the shape of the object.

Finalise your document:

1. Describe your different prototypes.
2. Explain why you have chosen your final solution.
3. Organise your information.
4. Insert important text, pictures, screenshots or videos.

Share your findings:

Present in your own words, how you were able to sort different boxes into different locations.

Design new solutions 
with Max and Mia

How can you improve recycling methods to reduce waste?

In this project, you will:
• Explore how better sorting methods for recycling can aid in cutting back the amount of waste that is discarded.
• Create and program a device that will sort recyclables according to their size and shape.
• Present and document the solution you have developed.

Design new solutions:

Design a solution to sort three objects of your choice. 

Consider one of the following: 
1. Sort the objects using a conveyor belt. 
2. Sort the objects using a robot arm. 
3. Sort the objects using two different devices. 

Document your new solution.
